summary: An evolving framework examining awareness, interacting contributors, discernment and constrained choice while valuing autonomy.

core_concepts.upstream: prior and current contributors influencing the present
core_concepts.autonomy: choice under influence and constraint; change is not compulsory
core_concepts.discernment: context-appropriate inquiry under uncertainty and time constraints
core_concepts.relationships_and_scale: contributors interact; analytical scale can reveal or obscure
core_concepts.outcomes: outcome alone does not establish decision quality
